title: Bipartite graph encoding
statement: Given a natural number $n$ and a Boolean matrix $A$ indexed by pairs of elements of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, encode the bipartite graph represented by $A$ as the pair encoding of the length-$n$ word consisting entirely of true values and the row-by-row word of entries of $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a Boolean matrix indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(n)\times\mathrm{Fin}(n)$
